description.value:
As an heir of House Kundarak, you take great pride in your family and in its work guarding the treasures of Khorvaire. Your house has always led the clans of the Mror Holds; it has never held the crown, but it is known for its professionalism, honor, and order. You might strive to live up to that reputation, put your own sense of honor before your family's, or rebel against the house's expectations and scorn the demands of honor.

Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Intelligence

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.JCuG08AYUlhGAxjZ]{Mark of Warding}

Skill Proficiencies: Arcana and Investigation

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulThievesToo]{Thieves' Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulThievesToo]{Thieves' Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP
